name: The Standard Group Plc
source: The Standard Group Plc audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2024 | CRON 20261013: H1 2025 column added from the Standard Group Plc unaudited half year results for the six months ended 30 June 2025 (issuer interim report, as carried by AfricanFinancials HY2025 filing summary, cross-checked against The Trading Room half year report of the same filing): revenue 789,151,000, total operating costs 878,800,000, net finance costs 52,100,000, pre-tax loss 133,013,000, loss for the period 133,013,000, loss per share 1.25. Total operating costs, Operating Expenses and the sign of Net Finance Costs follow the same convention as the stored FY2024 column. The interim statement prints no income tax line and the printed loss for the period equals the printed pre-tax loss, so Income Tax is stored 0 as in FY2024.
source_note: Gap fill 2026-10-13: Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax, Income Tax and Net Profit read from the same audited PDF the file already cites (Grant Thornton audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2024, https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/corporate/public/assets/reports/AUDITED_GROUP_RESULTS_FOR_THE_YEAR_ENDED_31_DECEMBER_2024.pdf). Revenue 1,843,206 less total operating costs 2,910,288 plus other income 77,885 equals the stored Operating Profit (EBIT) of -989,197; less finance costs of 110,558 equals the loss before tax now stored. Owners of the parent carried 1,021,398 of the loss and non controlling interests 78,357, which is why the printed basic EPS of -12.50 is on the parent share of the loss. | earlier note: Kes'000 x1000 to absolute KES. 2022 total comprehensive loss per the issuer is 1,029,567; its attributable split (owners 821,021 + NCI 44,184 = 865,205) does not reconcile to it - issuer inconsistency retained, bottom line = PBT + tax.

rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.source: Operating profit derived two ways that meet exactly on the Standard Group Plc audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2023. FY2023 (633,795) = revenue 2,381,425 plus other income (8,489) less total operating costs 3,006,731, and equally loss before income tax (722,538) less net finance costs (88,743). FY2022 (1,023,464) = 2,743,265 plus (215,676) less 3,551,053, and equally (1,187,826) less (164,362).
